body:
I did some tests on 4.6, 4.7.1, 4.8 dev 3 and latest master 7a3904e22. On 4.6 and 4.7.1 i get the mentioned errors, more than 250 errors in 30 runs.

On 4.8 dev 3 and master the amount of errors dropped to about 50 in 30 runs, and in some runs i got a different error:

```
ERROR: Required size for texture update (131072) does not match data supplied size (0).
   at: texture_update (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:2272)
```

I also got about two crashes in each version while running the tests, not sure if is related with this issue or not:
